tests.name: the preview scale clamp is not bottoming out on any skin

detail.note: scale is meant to cancel the fact that the figure is brought much closer than its honest fit distance. Clamped at 0.05 it stops cancelling, and the figure is then drawn at whatever size being that close makes it -- which is a window full of skin.

tests.name: every skin was framed on what it actually draws

detail.note: the declared envelope adds a reach factor to every glow group and over-counts a flame by design; falling back to it silently is how a skin ends up framed too small
